dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Aren't you taking part in training?

dialogues.speaker: Cipitz
dialogues.text: Training? Hmph, that's so boring! It's just lifting weights and running laps, what's the point in practicing all that!?

dialogues.speaker: Cipitz
dialogues.text: A true warrior relies on their own power and skill to achieve victory! Watch, I can take on a Tatankasaurus... Well, a baby Tatankasaurus, which is more than that lot can manage with their running in circles!

dialogues.speaker: Cipitz
dialogues.text: A—And another thing... Nappa's never undergone training either. What if she ran into trouble out here? As the future strongest warrior, it's my duty to protect her!
